a_re_enqueue_does_not_reset_a_refusal: enqueue is create-if-absent and never an update, so a later cycle cannot erase an outcome a worker recorded.
how_enqueue_uses_it: insert first, catch the integrity error. NOT check-then-insert, which is a race two scheduler processes lose together.
measured_by_the_verifier: five cycles over three sources leave three rows - scripts/verify_nativeforge_collection_job_store.sh
the_bound: 177 registry sources with no cadence have one perpetual slot each, so repeated cycles hold the store at 177 rows rather than adding 177 a cycle. A source that DOES have a cadence gets a new row per slot, which is correct: last week's missed window and this week's pending one are different work.
